_note: `thresholds` is what CI enforces and is set to MEASURED TRUTH, not to a target. `observed` is the exact behaviour of the shipped fixture set and is asserted for equality, so an improvement fails the suite just as loudly as a regression and has to be recorded here deliberately. `aspirational` is where this is supposed to get to; nothing asserts it. See max_audit.md H3.

observed._note: Every non-fallback fixture also reduces exactly 0%: BenchmarkRunner supplies a TokenHasher, so the engine elides and then rehydrates back to the original. The shipped set produces no reduction by two independent mechanisms — fallback (40%) and round-trip rehydration (60%).

combinedTightBudget._note: budget { maxInputTokens: 50, targetReductionRatio: 0.50 } — the shape Test 2 used to run against a private inline fixture pair.

humanevalOnly._note: 0 fallbacks because nothing happens, not because it succeeded. This is the subset Tests 1-5 used to run in place of the shipped set.

codexglueOnly._note: Never exercised by the regression suite before 2026-08-09. Would have failed the old maxFallbackRate: 0.0 immediately.

aspirational._note: The old `thresholds` block. Retained as the target, asserted by nothing. Restore these to `thresholds` only when the measured numbers reach them.

expectedMetrics._note: Misnomer retained for compatibility: `targetReductionRatio` is the BUDGET the tests pass to the engine, not a value they expect back.
